name: Spaces
where_agents_run: your Mac, plus any other Mac or Linux server you pair over SSH; a background service on each machine keeps agents running when the app is closed
license: MIT, free on Mac and Linux; iPhone app in invite-only TestFlight
checked_on: 2026-10-06 (site pass, GitHub repo and release; the developer's own feature list)
source_note: Checked against usespaces.dev (home page and FAQ), the GitHub repo yogesh-dhande/spaces (licence, languages, latest release v0.21.0) and a feature list the developer posted asking to be added. Not tried here (macOS only).

multi_provider_supervision.value: Claude Code, Codex and opencode, each shown as working, waiting on you or done

needs_you_signal.value: One Alerts list of agents waiting on you or done, across every machine

approve_deny_prompt.value: Answer in the agent's own terminal, from the Mac or iPhone; no approve button

cross_provider_delegation.value: Any harness can lead and any can be a child, through the Spaces MCP server

conversation_gui_view.value: Agent brief (status, questions, task list) beside a real terminal

session_organization.value: Projects and workspaces per task, each with its own terminals, processes and browser tabs

saved_prompt_library.value: Automations save a prompt that starts an agent on demand or on a schedule; no library

builtin_editors_browser.value: Editor with a diff view (comment a line, send it to the agent) and Chrome browser sessions

appearance_control.value: Configurable keyboard shortcuts; themes not in its docs

issue_tracker_pipeline.value: Not in its docs; an automation could run a triage prompt

worktree_management.value: A git worktree per workspace, with its own ports, URLs and dev servers

planner_orchestrator.value: One orchestrator agent starts children and hears back when they finish or need you

agent_to_agent_messaging.value: Agents start other agents, send them prompts and read their output over MCP, across machines

phone_no_new_app.value: Phone access is the iPhone app

remote_ssh.value: Pair other Macs and Linux servers over SSH; each shows in the sidebar

os.value: macOS 14+; Linux servers with systemd (Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, AlmaLinux) as remote machines; iPhone beta

app_shell.value: Native macOS app (Swift, AppKit), not Electron

background_process.value: Yes: a Spaces service on each machine; agents keep running when the app quits or updates

ram_vs_claude_desktop.value: About 430 MB (the developer's own figure, not measured here)

runs_in_terminal.value: Native Mac app, not a terminal tool

license_cost.value: MIT, free; uses your own agent subscriptions

extensibility.value: Spaces MCP server; no plugin SDK in its docs
